records.temporal_coverage: 2026-09-27..2026-09-29 (Stage 11C finding: NWS observations is a SHORT ROLLING window, re-verified empirically -- data available for 2026-09-19..2026-09-26 three days earlier had already aged out by this run)
records.notes: Stage 11C also confirmed NOAA NCEI annual ISD/ISD-Lite archive does not yet publish 2026 (latest published year: 2025, verified against https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/noaa/isd-lite/ directory listing), and the newer NCEI Access Data Service v1 endpoint returned a 502 Proxy Error on request -- both ruled out as real 2026 backfill sources for this run, not silently skipped.
